title: My 4 Year DSA Learning JOURNEY | Mistakes | Striver Love Babbar Pepcoding Apna College

It was 2021, in which we had written the first line of code in C++, after that, Mtech, then placement in startup, then Amazon's interview, then it didn't happen there, then 30-40 lakhs in Akamai, so this whole journey has a lot of teachers involved in it, whoever you are, brother, sister, sir, whoever you see, whoever the big people are,

Everyone is involved in this in phases. We have learnt from everyone. We have learnt from everyone's mistakes. We have learnt from everyone what to do and what not to do. And today when we can teach people, when people tell us that you teach very well, your way of thinking is very good, we are not afraid of taking a live class that if someone asks then what will we do. So this is a very long journey. And today we know a lot of things that we did not know at that time. So let's listen to a story. So everything started as we said in 2021.

In 2021, this video of Lovebubberji, complete DS Algo in 450 questions. So, out of the 12-11 lakh people who watched this, we were one of them. So, at that time, we came to know what is DSA?
